setup_scope: Observed download, extraction, released-feature text parsing and NPZ writing component sum; no single external acquisition clock. Original authors sensor feature extraction and manual/development time are not measured.
clock_scope: Every fresh worker process includes interpreter startup/imports, prepared data read/hash, train-only preprocessing, compile/calibration/checks, training/validation/selection, test prediction, serialization and exit. One-time data setup is separate and added once for a standalone cold-start illustration; it was not repeated for every worker.
publication_partial_scope: Packaging through source archive and ledger creation; later report rendering, final hashes and publication are recorded separately.

additional_boundary_tests.scope: Additional focused training tests after boundary fix; pytest duration only, external interpreter clock not recorded. Complete final suite then passed540 tests.
